		Dataset overview
	

A first-person calibrated stereo RGB video dataset capturing everyday human manipulation across objects, materials, tools, and multi-step activities. Every session is recorded as a synchronized left/right camera pair with per-session stereo calibration, giving the visual geometry of hands, object interaction, state… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/fpvlabs/stereo-550.
